name: GitHub Smart Downloader
description: Download GitHub repositories, folders, or selected files as ZIP archives directly from your browser.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self'; connect-src https://api.github.com https://github.com https://codeload.github.com https://raw.githubusercontent.com; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
